positions.title: Student Research Assistant
positions.description: Funded by the CWU College of the Sciences: Summer Undergraduate Research Experience Grant. Worked under the supervision of Dr. Arne Leitert to design a near linear-time +1-approximation algorithm for finding a set of minimum eccentricity shortest paths on chordal graphs.

positions.title: Summer Research Student
positions.description: Participated in a Mathematics REU under the supervision of Dr. Rachel Kuske and Dr. Andre Wibisono. Applied ideas from convex optimization theory and numerical analysis to develop a framework for analyzing stability and convergence rates of discretized continuous-time optimization models.

positions.title: Student Research Assistant
positions.description: Worked in a group with three other undergraduates under the supervision of Dr. Sooie-Hoe Loke to research the application of machine learning algorithms for solving differential equations. As a result, we developed and implemented an algorithm in python for the use of neural networks to solve Delay Differential Equations. Funded by CURM.

positions.title: Coding Instructor
positions.description:
Taught basic through intermediate coding skills to children aged 10-18. Created lesson plans and
assisted students in developing a final project to showcase the skills they learned.

honors.title: Computer Research Association - WP GHC Research Scholar
honors.description: Provided full funding to attend the 2019 Grace Hopper Celebration in Orlando, FL.

publications.title: On the stability of optimization algorithms given by discretizations of the Euler-Lagrange ODE
publications.publisher: Proceedings of the 2019 MIT IEEE URTC · Oct 13, 2019
